title: Smart Code Sorter X
subtitle: IntelliJ IDEA & Android Studio plugin that automatically organizes Kotlin class members by structure and conventions — with zero configuration.

sections.description: SmartCodeSorter keeps your Kotlin class structure consistent without any manual effort. Install it, press a shortcut, and your class members, constructor parameters, and nested classes are instantly organized following Kotlin conventions.
features: Sort class members (properties, init blocks, functions, nested classes) in one keystroke
Sort primary constructor parameters by group, then alphabetically
Sort on Save — auto-sort every time you save a Kotlin file
Pin any declaration in place with **// @nosort**
Settings panel: reorder property categories and toggle alphabetical function sorting
Summary balloon after each sort, e.g. "moved 3 properties, reordered 5 functions"
Supports K2 mode; works in IntelliJ IDEA & Android Studio

cards.title: Manual Sort
steps: Open any Kotlin file in IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio
Or go to **Code → Smart Code Sorter → Sort Kotlin Code**

cards.title: Sort on Save
steps: Go to **Code → Smart Code Sorter → Sort on Save**
Your code is sorted automatically every time you save
